# ⚔️ WELCOME TO AD ASTRA ⚔️

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

### 🎯 OUR GOAL

* A guild for players who enjoy raids, without the pressure of competition or strict requirements. Main or alts alike.

* No competition. No mandatory Discord. No unnecessary obligations.

* Just join, enjoy the raids, and have fun!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

### 📜 OUR ONLY EXPECTATION

* If you participate in raids, please contribute to Guild Challenges too!

💡 Every contribution counts. You don't have to complete an expensive challenge on your own — even partial progress helps.

* You can complete all challenges too, to pex your Guild Mastery.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

### ⚔️ RAIDS INFORMATION

* Event raids during event

* Otherwise regular depending guild level and marks

* Raids schedule : 18:00–20:00 CET ⏰

💡Raid times may be adjusted when needed to accommodate World Bosses (level 50+) and events.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

### ✅ WHO IS WELCOME?

Everyone interested in participating in raids! Main character or alts, it doesn't matter.

Play at your own pace, join the raids you're interested in, and enjoy IdleMMO your way.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
### 📖 NEW TO GUILDS? HERE'S HOW IT WORKS!

🏰 WORKING TOGETHER

* By completing Guild Challenges and participating in raids, we help our guild gain experience and level up. A higher guild level unlocks more possibilities for everyone!

* Helping the guild and doing raids will give you Gold, Combat EXP and Guild Mastery EXP.

📜 GUILD CHALLENGES

* Guild Challenges are shared tasks that ask members to contribute specific items.
* New challenges are generated each days.
* You earn personal EXP for every item you contribute, even if the challenge isn't completed.
* Completing a challenge gives the guild experience and Guild Marks.


⚔️ GUILD RAIDS

Raids are group activities where guild members fight enemies together to earn rewards.

* Raids consume Guild Marks, the higher level the raid, the more marks it requires.
* Check the guild's scheduled raids and choose the ones you want to join.
* Join the raid lobby.
* Once the timer reaches zero, the raid starts automatically.
* At the end of the raid, you earn gold, Combat EXP and Guild Mastery EXP.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 

📚 For more information, you can check the game wiki.
